name: MealNova India Benchmark Specification
purpose: 600-case real-world benchmark for the 50 Level 2.3 priority Indian foods.
rules: Final scoring requires real photos, not AI-generated images.
Record actual portion weight where feasible.
Do not expose labels/menu names to the vision model.
Holdout cases must never be used for tuning.
Keep benchmark truth immutable after holdout freeze.
